timing_contract.received: Recorder time.time() at callback entry; not driver publication or MPPI receipt.
timing_contract.stamp: Execution header is actual last ArmStatus CAN source time; ROS log stamp is log creation time.
timing_contract.valid_until: Driver minimum of status/joints/six-motor source deadlines and an active old command lease.
timing_contract.sampling: Execution messages are sampled at >=50ms unless flags change; counts are recorded samples, not all driver packets.
timing_contract.matching: Lease match means valid_until within 1ms of an observed joint command source stamp + .30s. Previous recorder packet is not necessarily the packet used inside MPPI; source ages do not expose all motor/joint sources.
timing_contract.goal_coverage: Recorder did not subscribe to goal; 17:03 republication cannot be verified here.

conclusion: Old lease clipping is directly visible in healthy-enabled packets and correlates with some waiting rejections. It is not proof of the exact MPPI callback state for each rejection, nor the cause of all pauses. After the last observed navigation delivery, cancelled-reference waiting is separate from command lease expiry.
